edges.label: make
edges.ty: kind:kind -> ?model:string -> instructions:string list -> allow:string list -> Project.t -> t
edges.src: (Agent.kind, string, string list, string list, Project.t)
edges.doc:
Sets up the agent for a project; nothing is started until the first
    prompt. [model], [instructions] and [allow] are for Claude Code (see
    [Claude.make]).

edges.name: Agent.prompt
edges.label: prompt
edges.doc:
Sends the user's prompt to the agent, starting it if needed, and puts
    a [Prompt] event on the bus. With [about], the agent is also told
    which definition the user had selected. Returns at once.

edges.name: Agent.answer
edges.label: answer
edges.doc:
Answers the request with this id. Does nothing if it is not waiting
    (already answered, or its turn has ended). With [Always], the
    patterns are remembered for the project (see [Permissions]).

edges.name: Agent.stop
edges.label: stop
edges.doc:
Stops the turn under way: the agent ends it and stays ready for the
    next prompt, with the conversation intact.

edges.name: Agent.forget
edges.label: forget
edges.doc:
Ends the conversation: the agent is stopped without a word and the
    next prompt starts a conversation with no memory of this one.

edges.name: Agent.take_cause
edges.label: take_cause
edges.doc:
What the agent last did to the project's files, and forgets it; if
    the agent did nothing since the last call, the cause is an edit by
    hand.

edges.name: Bus.emit
edges.label: emit
edges.doc:
Adds an event, stamped with the time on the project's clock, which
    carries on from the trace's last event.

edges.name: Bus.record
edges.label: record
edges.doc:
[record(path)] starts appending events to the trace file at [path].
    Events already in that file become the backlog, as if they had just
    been emitted, and the clock continues from the last of them. Returns
    how many events were loaded.

edges.name: Bus.start_over
edges.label: start_over
edges.doc:
[start_over(~archive, opening)] moves the trace file to the path
    [archive] and starts a new, empty trace in its place, opening with
    the events [opening]. The events so far are forgotten and the clock
    starts from zero.

edges.name: Bus.wait
edges.label: wait
edges.doc:
Blocks until there are events past the cursor, then returns them,
    oldest first, with the cursor past them. The flag is true when they
    are the events of a trace from its start: at the first wait from
    [origin], and after [start_over].

edges.name: Bus.all
edges.label: all
edges.doc: Every event so far, oldest first.

edges.name: Bus.last
edges.label: last
edges.doc:
The most recent event of a kind, if there is one and this version can
    read it.

edges.name: Claude.make

    [model] is passed to Claude Code if given. [instructions] are files

    [allow] are allowed-tool patterns, such as [Bash(make:*)], pre-approved
    on top of [default_allow] and of the patterns remembered for the
    project (see [Permissions]).

edges.name: Claude.stop
edges.label: stop
edges.doc:
Asks Claude Code to end the turn under way, if there is one; it stays
    ready for the next prompt, with the conversation intact. A process

edges.name: Conversation.start_new

    far is kept as `.portolan/conversations/<UTC time>.jsonl`, which
    `portolan replay` can play. The new trace opens with what a viewer
    needs to carry on: the project, the last build and test results, the
    current graph, and a `conversation {earlier}` event naming the kept
    file relative to `.portolan`.
